reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE methods adapt to shifting model performance via error-weighted averaging with trim_ratio=0.8 to handle unstable rankings

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → Ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
